decisions.title: Adopt a dataset-centric, operation-based Data Engine
decisions.rationale: The engine owns reusable operations while each dataset owns source-specific contracts and normalisation.

decisions.title: Use explicit browser/API/server/shared trust boundaries
supersedes: mixed src importer and privileged repository flow
decisions.rationale: Prevents secrets and privileged mutations from entering the browser bundle.

decisions.title: Use VercelRequest and VercelResponse handlers
decisions.rationale: This handler format was validated successfully in the Vite Vercel deployment.

decisions.title: Keep Supabase privileged credentials server-only
decisions.rationale: Server credentials bypass RLS and must never be exposed to client code.

decisions.title: Hash canonicalised source payloads with SHA-256
decisions.rationale: Stable hashes support unchanged detection and provenance even when object property order differs.

decisions.title: Reject structurally invalid full datasets before mutation
decisions.rationale: A malformed source must not create a partial canonical catalogue or deactivate valid records.

decisions.title: Use stable Forge-owned record keys and soft deactivation
decisions.rationale: Stable identity and recoverable history are required by AEGIS.

decisions.title: Use Vercel Cron as the initial scheduler
decisions.rationale: The backend is Vercel-centred and static reference data does not require high-frequency refresh.
